The evidence implies that the compound may act as a modulator or inhibitor of the transporter, possibly through a mechanism involving the enzyme delta-isomerase. The integration of these steps highlights a possible dependency on the enzyme's activity to reach the transporter, suggesting a role in the compound's pharmacological effects.
